thread:
alex.design: Uploaded a tiny iteration of the alerting compact preview. Goal: single-line rows, suppression visible on hover, keyboard-friendly. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/NEW-ITER (frame: compact-preview-a11y)

kira.pm: Quick ask: show suppression as inline pill or in a hover panel with explanation? Panel is clearer but might overflow on narrow panes.

alex.design: Panel preferred for clarity, fallback to inline pill when width < 320px. Keyboard should open panel on Enter/Space.

omar.eng: We'll render the panel in a portal so it doesn't clip. Use `aria-expanded` on the opener and roving tabindex for row navigation.

joy.a11y: For screen readers announce after mount: "Preview opened for <name>. Suppression: on/off." Use polite live region and delay ~60ms after DOM append. Avoid announcing during animation.

pat.prod: Copy decision: "Quiet window" vs "Snooze". Ops leans quiet, product leans snooze. Recommend quick usability run.

alex.design: Adding both variants to the test frames. Also badge contrast: current bg #F6F8FF + text #6B7280 fails AA at 12px.

omar.eng: Swap to bg #EEF2FF + text #374151 and a 3px focus ring token. I'll add design tokens `compact.badge.bg` and `compact.badge.fg`.

joy.a11y: Toasts should use `role="status"`. Undo must be keyboard focusable and announced. Add SR test steps.

a11y-bot: Please add `data-testid` attributes to preview opener and suppression toggle for automated tests.

alex.design: Will do. Handoff checklist: portal rendering, aria-live delay, badge token swap, optimistic toggle + undo snackbar, two wording variants for research. Pushing updates by EOD.
